terminal.scope: OS process counters since process creation, observed at caller snapshot; a terminal pre-exit snapshot excludes subsequent teardown. Working set may include shared pages; commit is not working set.

baseline.scope: OS process counters since process creation, observed at caller snapshot; a terminal pre-exit snapshot excludes subsequent teardown. Working set may include shared pages; commit is not working set.

job_before.scope: Fresh per-trial Job from assignment; includes assigned process and descendants; does not include pre-assignment startup. Commit is not physical working set.

job_live.scope: Fresh per-trial Job from assignment; includes assigned process and descendants; does not include pre-assignment startup. Commit is not physical working set.
